title: The station
speaker: Tamsin
text: The Vault protected a coastal station. Its channels and lights once served the whole harbour.

title: The keeper
speaker: Mara
text: I sent the letter. When the routes failed, I could no longer maintain this station alone.

title: Why the letter
speaker: Mara
text: The wave seal was our promise: a safe way home. I asked you to open the Vault so that promise could live again.

title: A coast awake
speaker: Bram
text: The routes are open, the lights are answering, and the harbour is home again.
